sourceDescription: NMC letter D-11011/500/2024-AcademicCell dated 12-09-2024 with CBME Curriculum 2024 and competency volumes; Community Medicine (CODE: CM) table read at text offsets 400000-500000 of 801400.
verification: Official NMC document text read through a web reader that quotes short rows and restates long rows. PDF bytes, the pinned SHA-256, sourceBodySha256 values, rendered pages and table-cell alignment were not independently verified. Identity of this file with the pinned source PDF is assumed from title and date, not proven. No source prose stored.
modeRule: Practical draft mode expected when the official level is SH; knowledge mode otherwise. One documented exception (CM7.9).
scope: All 135 Community Medicine references that lacked selected review evidence at the checked head (CM1.1-CM20.4; CM5.13 already reviewed).
observations: Reader reported every CM row as Core.
Topic headers for Topics 6 and 7 state one competency requiring certification, but rows CM6.6 and CM7.4 each show 5; recorded as reported.
limits: Editorial scope comparison only; no clinical, faculty, rights or canonical acceptance.
Programme, policy and statute names in official rows were not checked for currency.
The 154-reference original hold inventory is unchanged.
certificationCountReported values are reader-reported and need a rendered-page check before use.

rows.note: Official domain S at SH for "demonstrate knowledge"; practical draft explains a dietary change.
Official domain S at level KH ("describe and demonstrate" computers in epidemiology); practical draft mode is appropriate.
Official row says methods of population control; draft frames this as voluntary, rights-based approaches to unmet need. Scope retained, framing added.
Draft adds distinguishing supportive from potentially harmful practices; elaboration.
Official row text reads "GMNCI" where IMNCI is likely meant; draft uses integrated neonatal and childhood illness management.
